capabilities: Suspend webviews and iframes when the sidebar is collapsed
Restore webviews when the sidebar is expanded
Prevent error overlays when restoring webviews
extras: Requires Obsidian v0.15.0 or higher. Zero configuration; works out of the box.
intentEvidence: Suspends webviews (e.g. from the Surfing plugin) when the sidebar is collapsed.
problem: Webviews and iframes embedded in sidebars (for example from the Surfing plugin) keep consuming memory and CPU even when the sidebar is collapsed and unused.

relations.evidence: Suspends webviews (e.g. from the Surfing plugin) when the sidebar is collapsed.

summary: Resource saver that suspends webviews and iframes in collapsed sidebars to reduce RAM and CPU usage, restoring them when the sidebar expands.
